summary: Honors, recognitions, coaching accolades, and institutional citations earned in science teaching and research.

items.title: Outstanding Science Research Coach of the Year
items.subtitle: Division Science & Technology Fair (DSTF)
items.organization: Department of Education - Schools Division Office
items.description: Conferred for mentoring 1st Place Division Winners in the Life Science Category and representing the division as official delegates to the Regional Science & Technology Fair (RSTF).

evidence.label: Plaque of Recognition & Division Certificate
evidence.context: Awarded during the annual Division Science Culminating Assembly.

items.title: Best Demonstration Teacher in Science 7
items.subtitle: Division-Wide Learning Action Cell (LAC) on MATATAG Pedagogy
items.description: Recognized for delivering a benchmark demonstration teaching lesson showcasing the 5E inquiry cycle and differentiated formative assessment for 120 participating secondary science educators.

evidence.label: Certificate of Commendation
evidence.context: Signed by the Schools Division Superintendent and Education Program Supervisor in Science.

items.title: Institutional Teacher of the Year Nominee
items.subtitle: Excellence in Academic Teaching & Research Mentorship
items.organization: Division City High School Faculty Association
items.description: Nominated by peers and school leadership for sustained outstanding performance in instructional delivery and student laboratory mentorship.

evidence.label: Nomination Certificate & Citation
evidence.context: Faculty resolution endorsing institutional teacher award.
